propositions: Every typed configuration key emitted through _SECTION_CLASSES must have a colocated nonempty public_description field metadata that serves as the authoritative external contract.
The configuration reference generator must require nonempty description metadata and fail generation with the offending key named when a field lacks a description.
Generated Description column cells must each identify a user-visible effect or operational consequence, not merely restate type, default, or lifecycle.
Both _config_schema.py and _config_coercion.py must remain individually below the 800-line absolute module-size limit while adding required field metadata.
The generated docs/config-reference.md must escape table-sensitive content correctly while preserving all existing field types, defaults, factories, coercion, and runtime behavior.
